schema.help: Your Apple ID and its password stay on this server: they are how it signs in again when Apple ends a session. Apple asks for a code from one of your devices once.

appleId.title: Apple ID
appleId.description: The email address you sign in to iCloud with.

actions.label: Sign in with Apple
actions.description: Signs in to iCloud, as icloud.com does: Apple asks for a code from one of your devices, once.
